title: Arcturus Therapeutics
bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

Arcturus develops mRNA vaccines and therapeutics using lipid-nanoparticle delivery, with programmes in infectious disease and rare metabolic disease. It has partnered with vaccine manufacturers and government programmes. Clinical data and funding are the main swing factors.

Technology Exposure

  • mRNA vaccines
  • Lipid-nanoparticle delivery
  • Rare-disease therapeutics

What To Watch

  • Clinical readouts
  • Partnership funding
  • Cash runway

Record Notes

Editorial brief compiled 19 November 2026 from company disclosures, agency publications and press reporting. Figures are as reported by those sources and have not been independently audited; no live market data is used.
